items.title: New Windows 11 update fixes File Explorer menu mess
items.summary: With the November Patch Tuesday rollout, you can finally customize your right-click menu in Windows 11. It fixes 1,094 security flaws, too.
items.titleZh: 新的Windows 11更新修复了文件资源管理器菜单混乱
items.summaryZh: 随着11月补丁星期二的推出，您终于可以在Windows 11中自定义右键菜单。它还修复了1094个安全漏洞。

items.title: OpenAI, Anthropic face new oversight as New York’s AI safety law takes effect
items.summary: New York is preparing to enforce its sweeping AI safety law, requiring major developers like OpenAI and Anthropic to register, disclose safety practices, and report critical incidents or face fines.
items.titleZh: 纽约人工智能安全法生效后，OpenAI和Anthropic面临新的监管
items.summaryZh: 纽约正准备执行其全面的人工智能安全法，要求OpenAI和Anthropic等主要开发商注册、披露安全实践，并报告重大事件，否则将面临罚款。

items.title: Anthropic inks $3.4 billion deal for gas-powered data centers—the largest of its kind—to secure AI autonomy ahead of planned IPO
items.summary: Ahead of its estimated $1.3 trillion IPO, Anthropic secured power autonomy in the largest power generation equipment acquisition from an AI company.

items.summaryZh: 在预计1.3万亿美元的首次公开募股之前，Anthropic从人工智能公司收购了最大的发电设备，获得了电力自主权。

items.title: Elon Musk wants to build AI satellite factories on the moon—and now SpaceX will compete for NASA’s $10 billion in contracts to build a lunar base
items.summary: NASA wants to put astronauts on the moon for the long haul, while SpaceX envisions industrializing it long-term.
